name: fabriek
description: Fabriek, Callum's portable issue-delivery workflow: an update-dev skill that upstreams improvements to the shared dev system as reviewed PRs, an onboard skill that makes a repo a dev-system repo, an evaluate-sessions skill that reports an agent run's throughput, gate quality, token spend and waste, a query-factory-data skill that answers ad-hoc questions about factory latency and pipeline cost from the fleet database, a factory-state skill that says what the factory is doing right now, a backlog-triage skill that turns the open backlog into a page where the owner picks what to close, rewrite or prioritise, then applies those choices, and a dependency-chain skill that maps an issue's full dependency chain as a doc whose diagram links every issue.
